title: mentha nouletiana var. gallica
intro: Mentha nouletiana var. gallica, commonly known as Gallic Peppermint, is a subspecies of mint plant known for its distinctive aroma and flavor. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to relieve digestive issues, reduce nausea, and alleviate headaches. The therapeutic actions of Gallic Peppermint include its analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents present in Gallic Peppermint include menthone, menthol, and limonene, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
